name: Upbit Larry Williams breakout K=0.5 with MA5 filter and 5-day noise-ranked top-10 basket (sharebook-kr utrader v0.06)
author: sharebook-kr (Pystock)
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: Upbit KRW spot, daily candle (09:00 KST roll), tickers rotated daily.
indicators: Daily OHLC, 5-day noise mean, SMA(5) of close
entry_long: Daily. Basket = 10 KRW tickers with lowest 5-day mean noise (noise = 1 - |open-close|/(high-low)), admitted only if that noise < 0.6 (dual noise). Target = yesterday close + 0.5 x (yesterday high - yesterday low). Buy at best ask when price >= target AND today high <= target x 1.02 AND price >= yesterday 5-day SMA of close AND not held. Budget = equity/10 per coin.
exit: Sell all positions at 08:50 KST the next day (before the 09:00 daily candle roll); trailing stop: sell if gain >= 50% from target and price falls >= 5% from the day high (effectively inactive; comment says 40%).
stop_loss: No hard stop; trailing stop 5% from day high only after +50% gain
position_sizing: Equal weight equity/10 per selected coin
filters: MA5 filter; dual-noise < 0.6; 2% overshoot cap on entry
implementation_notes: Version 0.06; removes adaptive-noise K (earlier versions used K=noise) and MA-score bet sizing. Open used as previous close; checked on 1-second polling. Matches lineage of Upbit volatility-breakout variants.
